collection.title: Fiat 500e 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Fiat 500e 2020 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 500e, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
